objective: Explain when and why nearest-neighbour explanations help or hurt using frozen experiments, with evidence strength and unresolved mechanisms explicit.
required_axes: training/validation/test dataset sizes and effective sample sizes
class imbalance and neighbour label agreement
target and reference text lengths and truncation
primary_cohort: Ten judges on common valid cases; within-backbone matched cases. Local six judges full valid cohort sensitivity.
outcomes: own validation-selected pipeline F1 precision recall
Brier score and direction of probability shifts
Shapley decomposition of score versus threshold-policy effects
statistical_design: Equal cell weights with within-cell inclusion weights. Stratify by gold label and baseline error/headroom. Cosine ranks within dataset/backbone. Cluster uncertainty by dataset+target identity where repeated across backbones/judges. Observational associations are not causal effects. Use existing component/random controls for intervention evidence.
validation: Recover source hashes and canonical prompt matches; reproduce previous metrics before extending; compare case groups on paired controls; deterministic summaries and examples.
no_new_inference: Analysis and feature export only initially. Do not mutate experiments or regenerate any judge attempts.
deliverables: reproducible enriched case features and provenance
figures and report with scope limitations and requirement-by-requirement audit
